name: capell-app/agent-bridge
description: Connect AI agents and MCP clients to Capell with read-only package knowledge, scoped site capabilities, preview-then-confirm execution, and audited operations.

healthChecks.label: Agent Bridge package surfaces, providers, and install health are discoverable by Diagnostics.
